Best matches across sources. The ranked pool uses non-LinkedIn sources including Indeed, Glassdoor, Google Jobs, employer, government, council, and recruitment routes. Each listing keeps its source label and application route. SEEK remains search-only because it returned a human-verification page. Each role includes PDF résumé and cover-letter downloads, optional editable Markdown sources, a concise opening email, and a separate fit audit. The screening match is a prioritisation aid, not a guaranteed ATS result. Review matched terms, gaps, listing status, requirements, and wording before any manual application. Nothing is submitted automatically.

Shared dashboard access

Automation controls

After you sign in, these buttons use the authenticated server-side n8n proxy. Webhook URLs and tokens stay in Netlify and never enter the browser. Draft generation and interview preparation never submit an application or send an email.

Server-side automation is ready when the n8n workflows are configured.
